questions.prompt: What is the intent of the Template Method pattern?

options.text: Define the skeleton of an algorithm and let subclasses redefine certain steps without changing its structure
Define a family of interchangeable algorithms selected at runtime
Provide a simplified interface to a subsystem
Ensure a class has one instance

questions.explanation: Template Method fixes the skeleton and defers steps to subclasses. Swappable whole algorithms = Strategy; simplify = Facade; one instance = Singleton.

questions.prompt: What is the difference between an abstract step and a hook?

options.text: An abstract step must be implemented by subclasses; a hook has a default that may optionally be overridden
They are the same thing
A hook must be implemented; an abstract step is optional
Hooks can only appear in interfaces

questions.explanation: Abstract steps are required; hooks provide defaults and are optional to override.

questions.prompt: The Hollywood Principle ('Don't call us, we'll call you') describes:

options.text: The base class controls the flow and calls the subclass's steps
Subclasses call the base class to run the algorithm
Objects notify observers of changes
A client selects an algorithm at runtime

questions.explanation: Control is inverted: the base-class template method calls down into the subclass's steps at the right moments.

questions.prompt: How does Template Method differ from Strategy?

options.text: Template Method uses inheritance with a fixed skeleton; Strategy uses composition to swap an entire algorithm at runtime
They are identical
Strategy uses inheritance; Template Method uses composition
Template Method can only run once

questions.explanation: Template Method = inheritance + overridable steps; Strategy = composition + swappable algorithm object.

questions.prompt: What is the main limitation of Template Method?

options.text: It relies on inheritance, so variations can't be combined as flexibly as with composition
It always leaks memory
It cannot enforce step order
It requires a database

questions.explanation: Inheritance is rigid; mixing independent variations often calls for composition (Strategy/Decorator).

questions.prompt: The base-class method that holds the fixed algorithm skeleton and should NOT be overridden is called the ____ method.
questions.explanation: The template method defines the invariant skeleton and calls the varying steps.
